d: Deep charcoal hair is tied into a long, high ponytail with straight bangs framing a youthful face and sharp, vivid azure eyes. The athletic build is dressed in a white bra-top with a green gem, white harem pants, and a dark teal patterned cloak draped over one shoulder with gold trim and dangling gold tassels. A gold belt cinches the waist, while dark brown laced sandals cover the feet. A large black hawk with a grey beak and talons perches on the shoulder.
